name: Settlement Query Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of settlement instruction query to be executed.

INST.name: Instruction
INST.definition: Queries settlement instructions based on criteria excluding statuses.

STTS.name: Status
STTS.definition: Queries settlement instructions based on criteria that includes statuses.

STPD.name: Status Period
STPD.definition: Queries settlement instructions based on criteria that includes statuses during a period.
